inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL session acquires a named advisory lock with GET_LOCK and releases it with RELEASE_LOCK.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored GET_LOCK scalar result so its MariaDB integer metadata is isolated from the release operation and source table work.

fixture_notes: The fixed lock name is newly acquired with a zero-second timeout and returns numeric status 1 before the connection releases it during teardown.
determinism_notes: One fixed lock name and timeout are used; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
